title: Bryan Adams Will ‘Roll With The Punches’ For 2027 Australasia Arena Tour
summary: The veteran Canadian rocker will play arenas in seven cities on both sides of the Tasman.
contentText:
Bryan Adams will punch on when his Roll With The Punches world tour sweeps into Australia next February and March, for what will be his second full-scale trek of these parts within two years.

The veteran Canadian rocker will play arenas in seven cities on both sides of the Tasman, with Australian pop artist Natalie Imbruglia locked in as “special guest.”

As it stands, the ANZ leg of Adams’ Roll With The Punches trek gets underway Feb. 23, 2027 at Perth’s RAC Arena, then heads to Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide, Melbourne, Auckland and wraps up March 12 at Christchurch’s Wolfbrook Arena.

Frontier Touring is producing the shows, which follow Adams’ early 2025 visit for what turned out to be one of his biggest tours to-date of these parts.

The forthcoming tour is in support of Adams’ 16 th and latest studio album, Roll With The Punches , which dropped last August on the singer and songwriter’s own Bad Records label, and peaked at No. 3 on the Official U.K. Albums Chart.

Adams powered through 140 shows worldwide last year, and will play dates in the United States, Canada and Europe in the months ahead before heading down Under in the southern summer.

Tickets go on sale Monday, 20 July at 12pm local via  frontiertouring.com/bryanadams .
